scripture.verse: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.

sermons.title: Sermon 134 | Elijah's Appeal to the Undecided

scripture.verse: How long halt ye between two opinions? If the Lord be God, follow him; if Baal, then follow him.
Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins.
And they sang the song of Moses the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvelous are thy works, Lord God Almighty; just and true are thy ways, thou King of saints.
The Lord is slow to anger and great in power, and will not at all acquit the wicked.
Thus saith the Lord God; I will yet for this be enquired of by the house of Israel to do it for them; I will increase them with men like a flock.
And I, if I be lifted up, will draw all men unto me.

sermons.title: Sermon 140 | A Simple Sermon for Seeking Souls

scripture.verse: Whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.
For he hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.
